How guests describe a visit

Taken from what guests write in their Google reviews.

The atmosphere

7 Google reviews mention the atmosphere. One guest liked the 90s and 00s music at a reasonable volume.

The swings

Hanging swing chairs on the terrace. 2 Google reviews mention the swings.

Helpful people

2 Google reviews mention the owners. Guests write about helpful staff and excellent service.

A warm place

On Facebook Cunia calls itself a warm place with cozy vibes, which reminds that every day is a new day. Outside, blue and pink chairs and a flower wall with the name. Inside, the name in blue light above the counter.

What guests say

Three of 47 Google reviews, 42 of them with five stars.

“A relatively new brunching option, Makariou ajacent, in the centre of Nicosia, with great coffee, tasty brunch plates and good vibes! The staff was very helpful and the music was giving 90s-00s vibes which we really liked at a reasonable volume.”

Google review
“I really enjoyed the latte. It tastes very good! The atmosphere and vibe of the cafe is also very nice and relaxing. I would recommend to a friend!”
